summary: Parks! America, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing the appointment of Clear Trust, LLC as its transfer agent and shareholder support provider, effective August 7, 2026. The filing includes a shareholder letter dated October 14, 2026, explaining the transfer of directly held shares to Clear Trust's Clear Connect platform. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisors, or special-situation mechanics are present. This is a routine corporate administrative update with no risk-arb angle; no action from shareholders is required.
